name: Blood Lotus Palm
description: A palm strike that opens a petal of red qi against the opponent's flesh. The Pavilion's founding art — the qi torn from the wound returns, and knits the striker's own.

name: Crimson Tide Fist
description: A flurry of low fast punches that tear shallow crescents across a foe's meridians. The wounds do not cease — each beat of the heart lets a little more go.

name: Heart-Rending Claw
description: A single claw-like strike to the chest that hooks behind a rib and pulls — not flesh, but breath. The victim spends the following seconds re-learning where their lungs are.

name: Scarlet Chain Lash
description: A whip-fast lash of qi shaped like a chain of red flowers. Enemy-only — disciples learn it under blood oath, and do not teach.

name: Pond-Veil Step
description: A footwork art of the Scarlet Pavilion guardians — each step scatters a red mist that blurs a pursuer's strike. Enemy-only.
